_about: The Anatomy the viewer reads (viewer 0.110.0, 2026-11-10). types: each type of thing a brain holds, its facets and what each means, what it fits into, its contract. pages: each viewer page by its address, its pieces as a tree (sel finds the piece on the live page, idx picks one of several), each piece's parts, and the type a piece is an instance of. corners: the pieces every page carries. The '?' press on a page draws these on the page itself (anatomy.js). Written for every brain the kit makes; a brain's own additions are a later round. Changed by hand or by a session, never by the page.

task.name: Task
task.means: One thing to do, owned by one person: one line on a project's list with an open box.
task.fits: A project's list, under a heading. It shows on Today, on every thread it gathers on, and in the work in progress it answers to.
task.contract: One line: a box, the id, the day, the owner, the words, then each facet after a dot.

question.name: Question

thread.name: Thread
thread.means: A workspace: one subject, every item about it gathered, its state, decisions and what is needed to finish it.
thread.fits: A project, by its project facet; a thread can sit inside another thread.
thread.contract: A markdown file under projects/<project>/subjects/: a header of facets, then Where it stands, Decisions, Learned and Sources.

project.fits: The brain; a project can sit inside another project.
project.contract: A row in context/holon-registry.json, and a folder under projects/.
